name: APELink
summary: Melbourne national dialup ISP; formed Mar 1998, launched Jun 1999 on connect.com.au; gone by 2001 (ASIA PACIFIC ENTERPRISE LINK PTY LTD, ACN 082 100 409).

events.details: Formed March 1998 by directors Gary Samuels (MD), Tony Cheng, Patricia Wu and Bob Li; PO Box 210, Blackburn South VIC (ACN 082 100 409); signed connect.com.au May 1999 and launched national dialup service Jun 1999.
Defunct; last Wayback capture of www.apelink.net.au 16 Jun 2000, none thereafter.
